source.document: Mazda service information (Mazda MSI) — front sensing camera aiming, front radar / front side radar aiming, 360° View Monitor System aiming, and seat weight sensor calibration procedures.
source.note: Per user shop practice confirmed against MSI: no separate calibration is required for vehicles equipped with only a standalone rear backup camera (not part of the 360° View Monitor system). Mazda does not publish a parking sensor calibration procedure.

general_requirements: Per Mazda North American Operations: all vehicles being repaired for collision damage should be scanned before and after the repair. DTCs will be stored if any of the sensors, cameras, or radars were damaged in the collision.

components.location: Behind the front center brand emblem / front bumper surface
components.calibration_note: Front radar sensor aiming cannot be performed correctly if there is an object obstructing the radar emissions on the front center brand emblem or front bumper surface.
triggers: Front radar sensor is removed, installed, or replaced
Front bumper is removed or installed

components.location: Front corners, behind the front bumper
components.calibration_note: Front side radar sensor aiming cannot be performed correctly if there is an object obstructing the radar emissions.
triggers: Front side radar sensor is removed, installed, or replaced
Front bumper is removed or installed

components.calibration_note: If paint coat thickness has changed, the radar emissions angle will deviate. Replace the radar unit if struck; do not repair the bumper over the radar area.
triggers: Rear bumper is replaced
Side radar unit is removed, installed, or replaced
Side radar bracket is removed, installed, or replaced

components.calibration_note: FSC aiming stores the camera shot angle by either mid-drive (dynamic) aiming or stationary (static) aiming with a target.
triggers: Forward Sensing Camera (FSC) is replaced
Windshield is replaced

components.location: Four cameras: front (grille/bumper), rear mount, and left/right outer mirrors
components.calibration_note: Batch aiming requires four sets of SST 49 JP04 001; if not all four are available, each camera may be aimed individually. No calibration is required on vehicles equipped with only a standalone rear backup camera (without 360° View Monitor).
triggers: Front camera is removed or installed
Front bumper is removed or installed
Side (mirror-mounted) camera is removed or installed
Power outer mirror is removed or installed
Lower outer mirror garnish is removed or installed
Side turn light is removed or installed
Front door is removed, installed, or adjusted
Rear mount camera is removed or installed
Rear finisher is removed or installed

components.calibration_note: Per Mazda Two-Step Deployment Control System (US/Canada spec): replacement or disassembly events require seat weight sensor calibration via M-MDS; removal, bolt-loosening, and collision events require seat weight sensor inspection via M-MDS. Both procedures are performed on M-MDS.
components.trigger_lead: Calibration or inspection is required when:
triggers: Seat weight sensor is replaced
Seat weight sensor control module is replaced
Passenger-side seat parts are replaced with new parts
Passenger-side seat is disassembled
Passenger-side seat is removed
Passenger's seat fixing bolts are loosened and retightened
Vehicle is involved in a collision
